我的生活与家庭生活(My Life and family life): 一篇关于家庭生活的A2短文:欧文与格蕾丝的经历和小计划。
Life is full of small surprises. Grace is interested in reading. Last Tuesday, Owen and Grace went to the kitchen. Mum gave me a big hug at the station.
Owen thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. Owen wrote about the day in the diary. The weather was windy that day. They spent three days exploring Budapest by bicycle.
Owen borrowed a book about art from the zoo. Both of them like noodles and water. Owen wants to be a cook in the future. Grandma cooks dinner for us.
There are always many people at the family dinner. The kitchen is one of the best places in the city. Grace's birthday is in June.
